# Mediabunny 1.61.3

The unmodified browser bundle in `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` is vendored locally,
loaded only when a director video is exported. Export requires WebCodecs; no CDN or
external encoding service is used at runtime.

Source/package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.61.3.tgz

The downloaded package's SHA-512 integrity was verified against npm's package
metadata. `PROVENANCE.json` records the exact version, source and integrity.
The bundle is distributed under MPL-2.0; see `LICENSE`. The corresponding source
is available in the pinned package above and at https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny.
